schemas.name: code
schemas.description: Code mode: compute/join multiple tool results with JavaScript. For large exports, call source tools inside code and return only aggregates; save reusable intermediate JSON via context_write, not raw rows in chat. `await tools.pg_query({ env, sql, all: true })` (any tool by name; tools.call(name, args); await tools.list()), then work with the results in plain JS and print with text(...) (objects as pretty JSON); return a value too. Helpers: uuid now date rand hex diffLists diffLines log. console.log/info/warn/error are safely captured in logs. Pass context=id for nearby files via files.list/search/read/readFile/readJson/write/writeJson/edit/remove (async). Read before overwriting; conflicts reject stale edits. Sandboxed (files only through enabled dt tools, no direct filesystem; direct fetch is available, 60 s). The user sees the code and its output (embedded). Example: const r = await tools.pg_query({ env: "dev", sql: "select status, total from sales.orders", all: true }); const by = {}; for (const o of r.rows) (by[o.status] ||= []).push(Number(o.total)); for (const [s, xs] of Object.entries(by)) text(s, xs.length, (xs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / xs.length).toFixed(2)); Semantic workflow: use engine="node" for tools. First await tools.tool_describe({name:"semantic_query"}) for its input schema. List retained analysis ids with await tools.semantic_index({}). For entry/exit maps call tools.semantic_query({analysis:id,operation:"flowmap",from:{name:"entryMethod"},all:true}); inspect flowMap.nodes, edges, assumptions, complete and proof. Value trace: tools.semantic_trace({analysis:id,from:{kind:"method",name:"entryMethod",parameter:"input"},to:{kind:"call",name:"exitCall",argument:1},assumptions:[{expression:"input < 0",holds:false}],all:true}). Inspect sides[].data and sides[].control separately; Report exact assumptionEvaluation.status separately for each layer; do not infer one from the other. If state is running, poll the same tool with {job:result.job,waitMs:1000,all:true}; do not restart. Return only needed evidence plus view links; all:true expands the retained response, not analysis coverage or runtime proof.
